acceptance_predicates.description: Selected/all workloads can capture provider responses through a supported development route.
Replay authority is issued only inside the runtime-owned boundary.
Sealed replay runs without provider egress.
Development auth/signature/key warnings never block fixture mode.

definition_of_done: Exact-head record/seal/replay evidence passes for selected workloads and all-workload mode.
Independent review and hosted checks pass.

inputs.description: Existing task acceptance, evidence requirements, and development-only constraints.

outputs.description: Strict-schema task specification and generated coordination projections.

gates.description: All existing acceptance predicates and definition-of-done checks pass without weakening thresholds.
